name: ADX-BBz confluence trend-not-overextended
rationale: Bets on the confluence of two orthogonal reads: ADX confirms a real trend (not chop), while a MODERATELY positive Bollinger z-score confirms price is pushed above its mean but is NOT yet statistically over-extended (a blow-off). Entering inside this bounded band rides confirmed trend continuation while avoiding the over-extended top where reversion risk dominates. This is structurally distinct from plain ADX+momentum trend-follow (which uses ret_Nd, no location ceiling) and from pure bb_z washout reversion (which buys negative z): here bb_z is gated to a positive WINDOW (floor AND ceiling) and combined with a trend filter. Disconfirmer: if the bb_z floor never coincides with high ADX (trend without moderate stretch, or stretch without trend), the confluence produces few trades and no edge; the stop fires if the 'not over-extended' read was wrong and price was actually topping.
catalyst: confirmed trend coinciding with a moderate, non-over-extended upside stretch from the mean
